S: <int> Number of interior storage slots in the block, with slot zero as the seaside handover point and slot S+1 as the landside handover point.
n: <int> Number of seaside containers arriving at the seaside handover point.
m: <int> Number of landside containers already stored in the block that must be delivered to the landside handover point.
p: <int> Number of consecutive time units required to complete each lift or drop operation for both cranes.
sigma_w: <int> Initial slot position of the seaside crane at time zero.
sigma_l: <int> Initial slot position of the landside crane at time zero.

seaside_containers.id: <int> Sequence number of this seaside container, defining its required pickup order at the seaside handover point.
seaside_containers.target_slot: <int> Storage slot where this seaside container must ultimately be placed.

landside_containers.id: <int> Identifier of this landside container, ordered by non-decreasing deadline.
landside_containers.source_slot: <int> Interior storage slot where this landside container is initially located.
landside_containers.earliest_finish_time: <int> Earliest time at which this landside container may be dropped at the landside handover point.
landside_containers.deadline: <int> Latest time by which this landside container must be dropped at the landside handover point.
